Transformed from upstanding citizen to cold-blooded vigilante, Coxman unwittingly sets off a chain of events that includes a kidnapping, a series of deadly misunderstandings and a turf war between Viking and a rival boss. - Liam Neeson, Tom Bateman, Tom Jackson, Emmy Rossum, Domenick Lombardozzi (movie)

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. - Liam Neeson, Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson, Jonathan Banks, Sam Neill (movie)

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: While driving with his two kids, a man receives a phone call from an unknown assailant who claims there is a bomb in the car. Unable to exit the vehicle, he must now follow a series of twisted instructions while trying to figure out how to survive. - Liam Neeson, Noma Dumezweni, Lilly Aspell, Jack Champion, Matthew Modine (movie)

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible. - Brad Pitt, Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn, Richard Jenkins, James Gandolfini (movie)

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: Billy "The Great" Hope (Jake Gyllenhaal), the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most. - Jake Gyllenhaal, Forest Whitaker, Naomie Harris, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Oona Laurence (movie)

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: On Dec. 7, 1941, Japanese forces launch a devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, the U.S. naval base in Hawaii. Six months later, the Battle of Midway commences on June 4, 1942, as the Japanese navy once again plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II. - Ed Skrein, Patrick Wilson, Luke Evans, Woody Harrelson, Dennis Quaid (movie)

programme.title: Love the Coopers
programme.desc: For their annual Christmas Eve celebration, Sam Cooper (John Goodman) and his wife Charlotte (Diane Keaton) welcome four generations of extended family, including son Hank (Ed Helms), daughter Eleanor (Olivia Wilde) and Charlotte's father, Bucky (Alan Arkin). Sam and Charlotte are separating after 40 years of marriage, while Hank is in the middle of a divorce. As the guests reveal their respective problems, they also rediscover the importance of kinship and the spirit of the holiday. - Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Ed Helms, Diane Keaton, Anthony Mackie (movie)

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Three years after a fateful trip to the French Riviera, Jen (Katherine Heigl) enjoys the good life in suburbia with her handsome husband, Spencer (Ashton Kutcher). That comes crashing down, however, when gunfire rings out the morning after his 30th birthday. It turns out that Spencer has not been honest with Jen about his job; he's a deadly spy. Now she must learn to dodge bullets while keeping up an appearance of normalcy. - Ashton Kutcher, Katherine Heigl, Tom Selleck, Catherine O'Hara, Rob Riggle (movie)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn, Cheryl Hines, Christine Baranski (movie)

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor. - Dane Cook, Jessica Simpson, Dax Shepard, Andy Dick, Tim Bagley (movie)

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Lovestruck Dustin (Jason Biggs) is dating Alexis (Kate Hudson), his ideal girlfriend, but when she dumps him for coming on too strong, Dustin takes drastic measures to win her back. He asks his pal Tank (Dane Cook) to take her on a horrible date so that she will come running back to him, and Tank happily agrees. However, Alexis is more than a match for Tank's shock tactics, leaving him torn between loyalty to Dustin and a growing attraction toward Alexis. - Dane Cook, Kate Hudson, Jason Biggs, Alec Baldwin, Lizzy Caplan (movie)

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: Faced with deportation to her native Canada, high-powered book editor Margaret Tate says she's engaged to marry Andrew Paxton, her hapless assistant. Andrew agrees to the charade, but imposes a few conditions of his own, including flying to Alaska to meet his eccentric family. With a suspicious immigration official always lurking nearby, Margaret and Andrew must stick to their wedding plan despite numerous mishaps. - Sandra Bullock, Ryan Reynolds, Mary Steenburgen, Craig T. Nelson, Betty White (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Drama, Romance)

However, complications unfold when the two best pals add sex to their relationship. - Justin Timberlake, Mila Kunis, Patricia Clarkson, Jenna Elfman, Bryan Greenberg (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Hot Stove (Live)
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others. (Sports talk, Baseball)

programme.title: Overhaulin' - Daily Raptor

programme.title: Overhaulin' - Shaq's Classic
programme.desc: S10E12 - Shaquille O'Neal's heart is always in helping out the little guy and making those around him happy; his friend Anthony Chicago Hall wants to give back to a man who gives so much by fixing up Shaq's rust bucket '64 Impala. (Reality, How-to, Auto)

programme.title: Overhaulin' - Off-Road Masterpiece

programme.title: Overhaulin' - Rally-wreck, Reborn
programme.desc: S10E9 - A young rally-car fan works with his dad to get his WRX running, but no matter how hard they try, they can't get his Subaru purring; after several idle years, dad decides it's time to get his son into his dream rally ride. (Reality, How-to, Auto)

programme.title: Overhaulin' - The Knock Out Vette
programme.desc: S10E1 - A one-time heavy-metal singer trades life on the road for a life focused on family; over time, he scrapes together enough to buy a 2014 Corvette, and now his son wants him to stop settling and get the metal makeover his Stingray deserves. (Reality, How-to, Auto)

programme.title: Texas Metal's Loud and Lifted - Samurai and the Gladiator

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: When John Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) was a little boy, he made a wish that Ted (Seth MacFarlane), his beloved teddy bear, would come alive. Thirty years later, foul-mouthed Ted is still John's constant companion, much to the chagrin of Lori (Mila Kunis), John's girlfriend. Though Lori's displeasure is exacerbated by the pair's constant consumption of beer and weed, she's not the one who's most disappointed with John; it may take the intervention of John's boyhood toy to help him grow up at last. - Mark Wahlberg, Mila Kunis, Joel McHale, Giovanni Ribisi, Patrick Warburton (movie)

programme.title: Ted 2
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves. - Mark Wahlberg, Amanda Seyfried, Jessica Barth, Giovanni Ribisi, Morgan Freeman (movie)

programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview)

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission. - Owen Wilson, Gene Hackman, Gabriel Macht, Charles Malik Whitfield, Joaquim de Almeida (Action, War, Thriller, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri, Kearran Giovanni, Olivia Sanabia (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. - Woody Harrelson, Randy Quaid, Vanessa Angel, Bill Murray, Chris Elliott (Comedy)

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. - Seth Green, Breckin Meyer, Brenda Song, Clare Grant, Macaulay Culkin (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. - Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Brent Briscoe, Bridget Fonda, Jack Walsh (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon, having already defeated every army in Greece, uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy, the last kingdom preventing his control over the Aegean Sea. - Brad Pitt, Eric Bana, Orlando Bloom, Diane Kruger, Brian Cox (Adventure, War, Action, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. - Stuart Townsend, Aaliyah, Marguerite Moreau, Vincent Perez, Paul McGann (Horror)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (Thriller)

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors. - Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea, John Hurt, Rupert Graves (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin, Sean Bean, Thora Birch (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Deveraux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict. - Jean-Claude Van Damme, Dolph Lundgren, Ally Walker, Ed O'Ross, Jerry Orbach (Science fiction, Action, War)

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. - Matthew Gray Gubler, AnnaLynne McCord, Alisha Boe, Sheila Vand, Sam Eidson (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos. - Gene Hackman, Robert Stack, Fred Ward, Reb Brown, Randall "Tex" Cobb (Action, War)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth. - Mia Farrow, John Cassavetes, Ruth Gordon, Sidney Blackmer, Maurice Evans (Horror)

programme.title: Venom

Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - Shanti Lowry, Sophia Ali, Andrew Howard, Omar Gooding, Dylan Mooney (Thriller)

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot. - Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Edward Furlong, Robert Patrick, Earl Boen (Science fiction, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down. - Ben Affleck, Gary Sinise, Charlize Theron, Dennis Farina, James Frain (Crime drama, Thriller, Action)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon. - Kevin Eastman, Barry Gordon, Cam Clarke, Townsend Coleman, James Avery (Children, Documentary)

programme.title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
programme.desc: When Charlie Brown (Peter Robbins) enters the school spelling bee, the perpetually crabby Lucy (Pamelyn Ferdin) predicts his humiliation. But with the help of his best friend, Linus (Glenn Gilger), and faithful dog, Snoopy (Bill Melendez), Charlie Brown not only wins the spelling bee, he's chosen to attend the national spelling bee in New York City, leading to many misadventures in the big city. This is the first animated feature based on Charles Schulz's comic strip, "Peanuts." (Animated, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown!
programme.desc: In this animated feature, Charlie Brown (Duncan Watson), Linus (Liam Martin) and the gang head to Camp Remote, located in the Rocky Mountains, where the big event is the annual river rafting race. Competing against Charlie Brown and his friends is a gang of bullies who always win the race, owing to their penchant for dirty tactics and cheating. This time proves no different, and Charlie Brown has to overcome his lack of confidence if his team is to have any hope of winning. (Animated, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Hugo
programme.desc: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home. - Ben Kingsley, Sacha Baron Cohen, Asa Butterfield, Chloë Grace Moretz, Ray Winstone (Adventure, Fantasy, Drama)

programme.title: Scrooge
programme.desc: Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) is the definition of a miser. On Christmas Eve, however, Scrooge is in store for a rude awakening when he is visited by the ghost of his old business partner, Jacob Marley (Alec Guinness), who informs him that he is going to be visited by three ghosts, including the Ghosts of Christmas Past (Edith Evans) and Present (Kenneth More). - Albert Finney, Alec Guinness, Edith Evans, Kenneth More, Laurence Naismith (Family, Holiday, Musical, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: Advertising executive Darrin Hill (Cuba Gooding Jr.) loses his job and his girlfriend after his many lies about his background and education are discovered. Soon after, he returns to his small Georgia hometown to collect an inheritance from his Aunt Sally (Ann Nesby). To receive it, he must lead the church choir to victory in a gospel competition. With the help of childhood friend Lilly (Beyoncé Knowles), now a beautiful singer, Darrin gets the choir ready to perform. - Cuba Gooding Jr., Beyoncé Knowles, Melba Moore, Mike Epps, LaTanya Richardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Everybody's Fine
programme.desc: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be. - Robert De Niro, Drew Barrymore, Kate Beckinsale, Sam Rockwell, Melissa Leo (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. - Dennis Quaid, Rene Russo, Danielle Panabaker, Sean Faris, Rip Torn (Children, Comedy)

programme.title: A Very Brady Sequel

With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. programme.title: Seabiscuit

At first the horse struggles to win, but eventually Seabiscuit becomes one of the most successful thoroughbreds of all time, and inspires a nation at a time when it needs it most. - Tobey Maguire, Jeff Bridges, Chris Cooper, Elizabeth Banks, Gary Stevens (Historical drama)

programme.title: Show Dogs

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Mr. Holmes

programme.title: Charlotte's Web
programme.desc: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider (Julia Roberts) weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block. - Dakota Fanning, Kevin Anderson, Gary Basaraba, Beau Bridges, Essie Davis (Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest

Suddenly, even her best friends are against her, and Harriet resolves to take revenge. - Michelle Trachtenberg, Rosie O'Donnell, Vanessa Lee Chester, Gregory Smith, J. Smith-Cameron (Children, Comedy drama)

What Tristan finds, however, is not a chunk of space rock, but a woman named Yvaine. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. - Jason Bateman, Olivia Munn, T.J. Miller, Jennifer Aniston, Kate McKinnon (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp. - Giorgia Whigham, Corbin Bernsen, Kue Lawrence, Paul Soter, Pierson Fode (Horror, Thriller)

After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Outside Providence
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age comedy, Tim Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is leading a go-nowhere existence, spending his days smoking pot and hanging out with his best friend, Drugs Delaney (Jon Abrahams). The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately. - Shawn Hatosy, Jon Abrahams, Tommy Bone, Jonathan Brandis, Jack Ferver (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Tommy Boy

programme.title: The Cut

His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul. - Orlando Bloom, Caitriona Balfe, John Turturro, Clare Dunne, Gary Beadle (Thriller, Drama)

She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete. - Jennifer Lopez, Edward James Olmos, Jon Seda, Constance Marie, Jacob Vargas (Biography, Drama)

She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. With the help of Alex and his children, Katie learns to love and trust again, but when a mysterious stranger arrives and starts asking questions, Katie's dark past threatens to reclaim her. - Josh Duhamel, Julianne Hough, Cobie Smulders, David Lyons, Noah Lomax (Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery, Fantasy)

programme.title: Four Letters of Love
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together. - Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter, Gabriel Byrne, Ann Skelly, Fionn O'Shea (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Almost Famous

When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

After an attempt at securing the services of a prostitute goes slightly awry, Joel hires gorgeous Lana for a night of delight. Stunned by the amount of Lana's "bill" the next morning, Joel grows frantic after he crashes his father's Porsche. In an effort to raise lots of money fast, a desperate Joel turns the house into a brothel. - Tom Cruise, Rebecca De Mornay, Bronson Pinchot, Joe Pantoliano, Richard Masur (Comedy)

programme.title: Old School

He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy)

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. - Rico Verhoeven, Frank Grillo, Roland Møller, Rona-Lee Shim'on, Kevin Janssens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. - Ryan Phillippe, Abbie Cornish, Channing Tatum, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Ciarán Hinds (Drama, War)

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye. - Nicholas Hoult, Kevin Spacey, Sarah Paulson, Hope Davis, Victor Garber (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Racing With the Moon
programme.desc: In their last weeks before deployment to World War II as Marines, teenage friends Henry Nash (Sean Penn) and Nicky (Nicolas Cage) try to make the best of the time they have left in their small California town. When Nash spots Caddie Winger (Elizabeth McGovern), a new girl in town he mistakenly believes to be wealthy, he sets about winning her over. But the good times are ruined when Nicky finds himself trying to solve a serious predicament, and implicating Nash and Caddie in the process. - Sean Penn, Elizabeth McGovern, Nicolas Cage, John Karlen, Rutanya Alda (Romance)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Blue Eyed Girl
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been. - Marisa Coughlan, Beau Bridges, Eliza Coupe, Freddy Rodriguez, Sam Trammell (Comedy drama)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). - Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Andy Garcia, Eli Wallach (Crime drama)

programme.title: Shutter Island

The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. - Omar Sy, Jay Abdo, Mahmood Bakri, Saleh Bakri, Ziad Bakri (Drama)

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial
programme.desc: Skeptical lawyer Barney Greenwald (Eric Bogosian) grudgingly defends Lt. Steve Maryk (Jeff Daniels), a navy man who wrestled control of a ship from its domineering captain, Lt. Cmdr. Philip Francis Queeg (Brad Davis), in the midst of a violent storm at sea. As the court-martial progresses, Greenwald begins to wonder if the events aboard the U.S.S. Caine were truly a mutiny, or merely the brave acts of a faithful group of sailors who could no longer trust their unstable leader. - Eric Bogosian, Jeff Daniels, Brad Davis, Peter Gallagher, Michael Murphy (Drama)

programme.title: Alone in Berlin
programme.desc: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi. - Emma Thompson, Brendan Gleeson, Daniel Brühl, Mikael Persbrandt, Katharina Schüttler (Historical drama)

programme.title: The Dark Tower

The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer and a domesticated bear try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester. - Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Joan Cusack, Christina Ricci (Comedy, Dark comedy, Family, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Kirk, now an admiral, is called upon to take command of his old ship one last time in order to intercept a bizarre and deadly force heading towards Earth. One by one, he reassembles the original crew, and they set out to save the planet. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei (Action, Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: The past returns to haunt Admiral James Kirk when he and his crew become locked in a battle of wits with an old nemesis. His enemy Khan is looking for revenge and a potentially destructive device. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, Paul McGann, Herbert F. Solow (Action, Adventure, Documentary, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, Michael Dorn, F. Murray Abraham (Action, Adventure, Movie, Romance, Science Fiction)

programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs. - Mel Gibson, Joanne Samuel, Hugh Keays-Byrne, Steve Bisley, Tim Burns (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Thriller)

programme.desc: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: A party of high school students settle in a woodland cabin for the weekend. When they find and read a copy of 'The Book of the Dead', a tome that raises not just demons outside the walls but within, they become demonically possessed with murderous desires. - Bruce Campbell, Ellen Sandweiss, Betsy Baker, Richard DeManincor, Theresa Tilly (Horror, Movie)

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets. - Lance Guest, Robert Preston, Dan O'Herlihy, Chris Hebert, Kay E. Kuter (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction)

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee. - Michael York, Jenny Agutter, Richard Jordan, Roscoe Lee Browne, Farrah Fawcett (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival. (Documentary, Entertainment, Show, Special)

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures. - Kerwin Mathews, Kathryn Grant, Richard Eyer, Torin Thatcher, Alec Mango (Action, Adventure, Family, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: A hotshot rookie stock car driver sets his sights on the professional NASCAR circuit and the prestigious Daytona 500. - Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall, Nicole Kidman, Randy Quaid, Cary Elwes (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance)

Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children. - Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts, Bob Hoskins, Maggie Smith (Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family, Fantasy)

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects. - Henry Thomas, Dee Wallace, Peter Coyote, Drew Barrymore, Robert MacNaughton (Adventure, Family, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen and a team of rebels from District 13 prepare for the final epic battle that will decide Panem’s future. - Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth, Woody Harrelson, Elizabeth Banks (Action, Adventure, Movie, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Science Fiction)

programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Classics
programme.desc: It's the most wonderful time of the year! From the Grinch's Christmas mischief to the romance of 'Last Christmas', celebrate the season with our festive Cinema List. (Documentary, Show, Special)

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads? - Jason Lee, David Cross, Cameron Richardson, Jane Lynch, Justin Long (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Family)

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian. - Zachary Levi, David Cross, Jason Lee, Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Family)

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon. - Jason Lee, David Cross, Jenny Slate, Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. programme.title: What On Earth?

Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety. - Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian, Carmen Electra, G-Thang (Comedy)

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: As television writer Jerry Stahl (Ben Stiller) becomes more successful, his heroin habit grows worse. Already using when he comes to Los Angeles, Stahl finds his problems intensify when he moves in with his friend Nicky (Owen Wilson), also an addict. Eventually, Stahl marries producer Sandra (Elizabeth Hurley) to help her get a green card, and she gets him jobs on top television shows. However, more and more, he is unable to separate his addiction from his working life. - Ben Stiller, Elizabeth Hurley, Maria Bello, Owen Wilson, Lourdes Benedicto (Drama, Romance, Biography, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Demon Knight
programme.desc: Ex-soldier Frank Brayker (William Sadler) is the guardian of an ancient key that can unlock tremendous evil; the sinister but charming Collector (Billy Zane) is a demon who wants the key so he can initiate the apocalypse. On the run from wicked mercenaries for almost 90 years, Brayker finally stops in at a boarding house in New Mexico where -- with the help of its quirky residents -- he plans to face off against the Collector and his band of ghouls, preventing them from ever seizing the key. - Billy Zane, William Sadler, Jada Pinkett, Brenda Bakke, CCH Pounder (Horror, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Purple Violets
programme.desc: After the commercial failure of her critically acclaimed first novel, Patti Petalson (Selma Blair) takes a job in real estate. Married to unfaithful chef Chazz (Donal Logue), Patti is startled by a chance encounter with her former boyfriend, Brian Callahan (Patrick Wilson), now a best-selling author. As the two renew their interest in each other, Patti's teacher friend, Kate (Debra Messing), also rekindles her college relationship with Michael (Edward Burns), a lawyer and mutual friend. - Selma Blair, Edward Burns, Debra Messing, Patrick Wilson, Dennis Farina (Romance, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Lay the Favorite
programme.desc: A former stripper's (Rebecca Hall) talent with numbers lands her a job with a professional gambler (Bruce Willis) who runs a sports book in Las Vegas. - Bruce Willis, Rebecca Hall, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Vince Vaughn, Joshua Jackson (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
programme.desc: Fired from the National Security Agency, Frans Balder recruits hacker Lisbeth Salander to steal Firewall, a computer program that can access codes for nuclear weapons worldwide. The download soon draws attention from an NSA agent who traces the activity to Stockholm. Further problems arise when Russian thugs take Lisbeth's laptop and kidnap a math whiz who can make Firewall work. Now, Lisbeth and an unlikely ally must race against time to save the boy and recover the codes to avert disaster. - Claire Foy, Beau Gadsdon, Sverrir Gudnason, LaKeith Stanfield, Sylvia Hoeks (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Small Time
programme.desc: A young man (Devon Bostick) decides to skip college and join his father (Christopher Meloni) as a used-car salesman. - Christopher Meloni, Bridget Moynahan, Dean Norris, Xander Berkeley, Devon Bostick (Drama)

programme.title: Alpha Alert
programme.desc: Three soldiers get trapped in an elevator when terrorists set off a dirty bomb; after one escapes, her world turns upside down when she realizes that nothing is what it seems to be. - Jennifer Morrison, James Frain, Josh Stewart, Kimberly Elise, Jude Ciccolella (Thriller)

programme.title: The Lucky Ones
programme.desc: Stuck at a closed airport while on leave from Iraq War service, soldiers Colee Dunn (Rachel McAdams), Fred Cheaver (Tim Robbins) and T.K. Poole (Michael Peña) decide to carpool to get to their far-off destinations. Colee wants to visit with her late fiancé's family, while wounded T.K. longs to see his future wife and Fred, needing fast cash to send his son to college, is headed for a casino. During the journey, the soldiers forge a bond based on their uncertain futures. - Rachel McAdams, Tim Robbins, Michael Peña, Molly Hagan, Mark L. Young (Drama)

programme.title: Freezer
programme.desc: A man (Dylan McDermott) fights for his life when Russian thugs lock him inside a freezer, accusing him of stealing millions of dollars. - Dylan McDermott, Peter Facinelli, Yuliya Snigir, David McNally, Milan Malisic (Thriller, Action)

programme.title: A Christmas Scam
programme.desc: When missing money threatens his annual Christmas concert, an R&B singer confronts a trusted friend's betrayal. But a hidden illness and an unexpected family connection reveal a more complicated truth. - Sir Charles Jones, K.D. Aubert, Cocoa Brown, Montreal Diggs, Natasha Aramis (Holiday, Drama)

programme.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
programme.desc: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You." (Holiday, Special, Entertainment, Music)

programme.title: The Perfect Holiday
programme.desc: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say. - Gabrielle Union, Morris Chestnut, Queen Latifah, Terrence Howard, Malik Hammond (Children, Holiday, Romance)

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiancé. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage. - Rachel McAdams, Channing Tatum, Sam Neill, Scott Speedman, Wendy Crewson (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Beatriz at Dinner
programme.desc: Beatriz is a Los Angeles massage therapist and holistic healer who drives to the seaside mansion of her client Cathy. When her old Volkswagen breaks down, she receives a friendly invitation from Cathy to stay for a seemingly innocent business dinner. As the guests arrive and the wine starts to flow, Beatriz finds herself in an escalating war of words with Doug Strutt, a ruthless real estate mogul who cares more about money than people. - Salma Hayek, John Lithgow, Connie Britton, Chloë Sevigny, Jay Duplass (Dark comedy)

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first? - Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher, Cary Elwes, Kevin Kline, Lake Bell (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Wanderlust
programme.desc: George (Paul Rudd) and Linda (Jennifer Aniston) have overextended, overstressed lives in Manhattan. After George loses his job, he and Linda have little choice but to move to Atlanta and stay with his terrible brother. On the way, the couple happen upon Elysium, an idyllic counterculture community, where money, careers and clothing are strictly optional. George and Linda think that they can make a fresh start in Elysium, only they may be trading one set of problems for another. - Paul Rudd, Jennifer Aniston, Justin Theroux, Malin Akerman, Kathryn Hahn (Comedy)

programme.desc: Small-time criminal Watty Watts (Gil Bellows) attempts to rob a convenience store with his drug-addict buddy, Billy Mack Black (Rory Cochrane). Heading toward Mexico, the fugitive couple gets plenty of media coverage, until there are even more people on their trail. Can Watty and Starlene make it south of the border without getting caught? - Gil Bellows, Renée Zellweger, Rory Cochrane, Jeffrey Combs, Jace Alexander (Action)

When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself. - Spencer Tracy, Felipe Pazos, Harry Bellaver, Donald Diamond, Don Blackman (movie)

Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges. - Spencer Tracy, Gene Tierney, Van Johnson, Leo Genn, Dawn Addams (movie)

Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision. - Burt Lancaster, Robert Ryan, Will Geer, Gilbert Green, John Anderson (movie)

Guerrero (Van Heflin) threatens to blow up an airliner. programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons - Daffy tailleur; Coyote, le bâtisseur de routes

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons

programme.title: Hôtel Transylvanie: la série - Petite Wendy deviendra grande; Mauvaise copie

programme.title: Il pleut des hamburgers - Flint Kong; L'invention du Siècle

programme.title: Il pleut des hamburgers - Sacrée Sardine; nuageuse avec risque de nuages
programme.desc: Par accident, Flint donne vie à Sal la Sardine, l'immense statue en Sardinium qui garde l'entrée du port. - Mark Edwards, Katie Griffin, David Berni (Animated, Children)

programme.desc: Mal à l'aise parmi les Mysticons, Zarya retrouve sa meilleure amie d'enfance, Kitty Boone, capitaine d'une bande d'astropirates. - Alyson Court, Nicki Burke, Evany Rosen (Animated, Children)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Une nuit à l'opéra

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Comme Cyrano

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Les sanglots de l'angoisse

Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Paul Walker, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe (Romantic comedy, Drama)

Callica, Andres Soto (Holiday, Romance)

Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? - Tom Hanks, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Stanley Tucci, Chi McBride, Diego Luna (Comedy drama)

Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. - Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash, Adam Rodriguez (Comedy drama)

programme.desc: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. - Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps, Alfre Woodard, Dennis Haysbert, Debbi Morgan (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You

Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. - Ben Affleck, Jennifer Aniston, Drew Barrymore, Jennifer Connelly, Kevin Connolly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Blue Valentine

But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. - Ryan Gosling, Michelle Williams, Faith Wladyka, John Doman, Mike Vogel (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason

On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home. - Ben Kingsley, Sacha Baron Cohen, Asa Butterfield, Chloë Grace Moretz, Ray Winstone (Adventure, Fantasy, Drama)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Liam Neeson, Jim Broadbent (Historical drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. - Elisabeth Harnois, Morgan Kelly, Kimberly-Sue Murray, Thomas Mitchell, Victoria Sanchez (Thriller)

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: In the Los Angeles Police Department, Officer Dennis Peck (Richard Gere) is a divisive figure, loved by those who are loyal to him and looked on with suspicion by others. His disreputable behavior and dubious finances arouse the suspicion of Internal Affairs, and Sgt. Raymond Avila (Andy Garcia) and his partner (Laurie Metcalf) are assigned to investigate. When a series of witnesses are murdered, Avila realizes his life is in danger, along with that of his wife (Nancy Travis). - Richard Gere, Andy Garcia, Nancy Travis, Laurie Metcalf, Richard Bradford (Crime drama, Thriller, Action, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. - Pierce Brosnan, Luke Bracey, Olga Kurylenko, Bill Smitrovich, Will Patton (Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Adventure)

When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott, Jerry O'Connell, Jessica Szohr (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension

After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley, Dan Gill, Ivy George (Horror, Thriller)

Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)
